stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder in trace 49dd876a7b4f86af700750c365a2e16a (span 436df66f4168fa4d, ~17:34:20Z, duration 34698 us) is recorded as ERROR with otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13, with status description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token.'

The payment service span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (span 1846805176a397a0) in trace 49dd876a7b4f86af700750c365a2e16a is ERROR with message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', traced to charge.js:37; checkout's client-side oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span (bfe7ac258e116f41) in the same trace is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=2.

The same trace carries HTTP 500 errors up the chain: frontend-proxy ingress (http.status_code=500), frontend POST and executing api route /api/checkout (http.status_code=500), and frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code=13; the frontend exception message is '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card ... Payment request failed. Invalid token.'

Inside the failed trace, checkout's other dependency calls are not errors: oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 1168 us, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 6647 us and 935 us, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 622 us, and oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 12598 us all carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0; the shipping server span POST returned http.status_code=200 and currency server spans returned otel.status_code=OK.

Two other checkout traces in the 5-minute window succeeded: 43a06db76ce6a61725d5c16d37784f47 (PlaceOrder 67418 us) and ec0dd949b9baaa1f62d01031b2eea6db (PlaceOrder 52025 us), both with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 on PlaceOrder, PaymentService/Charge (7306 us and 4806 us), CartService/GetCart and EmptyCart, ShippingService/GetQuote and ShipOrder, CurrencyService/Convert, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, and HTTP 200 at frontend/frontend-proxy and at email POST /send_order_confirmation.

Cart handled a separate add-item request near the window end in trace 9fb0bf666affea99d1fab157e8fbbd7f (~17:34:59Z) with HTTP 200 at frontend and frontend-proxy and rpc.grpc.status_code=0 on CartService/AddItem and CartService/GetCart; Redis spans HGET/HMSET/EXPIRE carry no status tag.

Product-catalog served GetProduct successfully in trace 73bf74e4ec3af494ffbd4c962fba4601 (~17:35:09Z): server span 281 us with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, client span 1505 us, and HTTP 200 at frontend/frontend-proxy.

The observed checkout error is a payment-side charge rejection (invalid token) rather than a checkout defect or a failure of checkout's other dependencies: the failing span is checkout's call to payment, the payment server span carries the exception, and every other dependency call in that trace returned status 0.

Against a window-wide dependency outage: two checkout traces roughly 2 minutes before the failure completed end-to-end with HTTP 200 and status 0 on payment, cart, email, shipping, currency and product-catalog, and cart and product-catalog request traces sampled near 17:35Z were also healthy; the failure is therefore not shown to be continuous across the window.

Rejected: that the checkout error in trace 49dd876a7b4f86af700750c365a2e16a originated in cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping or email. Their spans on that trace are visible with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 / http.status_code=200, and the only error is on the payment charge path.

The sampled spans do not support a claim of elevated latency: successful PlaceOrder durations in the sample are 67418 us and 52025 us and the failed one is 34698 us, dependency calls are in the sub-millisecond to ~13 ms range, and no comparable baseline series was obtainable in this run, so no latency trend can be asserted.

gaps: No metrics evidence at all: every metrics_range_query attempt (traces_span_metrics_calls_total by service/status, a bare increase over http_server_request_duration_seconds_count, an ERROR-filtered increase, and app_payment_transactions_total, across 5-minute and 2-minute windows and 30s/60s steps) returned status=error with reason SOURCE_ERROR and citable_as_fact=false. Error counts, ERROR-series values, per-service error rates and any latency histogram/baseline for checkout, payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping and email are therefore unknown, not zero.
The claim that checkout errors are 'elevated' cannot be verified or refuted without the unavailable metrics series; no error-rate ratio or comparison period was observable.

Only a biased sample of traces was available: three checkout traces in total (two successful around 17:31:46Z-17:32:04Z, one failed at ~17:34:20Z), with backend_traces_returned limited by the requested limits and incomplete_reason stating more traces may exist. Trace span counts here are not unique request counts and the sample cannot establish an error rate.

traces_search for email (window 17:32:11Z-17:35:11Z) and for currency (window 17:33:11Z-17:34:11Z) returned status=no_data with zero traces, which is unknown rather than evidence of zero calls or of health; email and currency were only observed as spans inside other services' traces.

Some trace parents are not visible (frontend-proxy ingress spans reference parent span 7405b13332eb12a8 / 37152e4f35205704 that was not returned) and many cart/payment/email internal spans carry no status tag (status_state=not_recorded, i.e. Unset, not OK), so the full call chain and the true status of those internal operations remain unknown.
No logs, deployment/config history or payment token/loyalty-level context was available to explain why the 'Invalid token' rejection occurred or whether it is systematic.
next_steps: Restore or re-check the Prometheus-backed metrics path and re-run the error-rate and latency queries (traces_span_metrics_calls_total by service_name/status_code, rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket, app_payment_transactions_total) before drawing any conclusion about elevated checkout error rate or latency trend.

Pull a larger, unbiased set of checkout and payment traces (and backend trace counts) over the same 5 minutes so an error rate for PaymentService/Charge can be computed instead of inferred from one failing trace.

Have a human inspect the payment service's token validation path around 2026-10-18T17:34:20Z (charge.js token check, loyalty level 'gold' requests) to determine whether the 'Invalid token' rejection is a persistent configuration/data issue.
Confirm whether frontend HTTP 500s on /api/checkout are being counted as checkout errors in the alerting that produced the report, since the observed 500s are payment-driven.
report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes of the authorized window (2026-10-18T17:30:11Z to 17:35:11Z), the sampled traces show one failed checkout and two successful checkouts. The failure is trace 49dd876a7b4f86af700750c365a2e16a (~17:34:20Z): checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span (436df66f4168fa4d) is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and its child payment span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (1846805176a397a0) is ERROR with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; the same failure surfaces as HTTP 500 at frontend-proxy and frontend. In that same failed trace, checkout's other dependency calls (cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping) all returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0, so I observed no failure in those dependencies. Two earlier checkout traces in the window, 43a06db76ce6a61725d5c16d37784f47 and ec0dd949b9baaa1f62d01031b2eea6db, completed with HTTP 200 and rpc status 0 on every dependency, including payment Charge (7.3 ms / 4.8 ms) and email POST /send_order_confirmation (HTTP 200). Cart (trace 9fb0bf666affea99d1fab157e8fbbd7f) and product-catalog (trace 73bf74e4ec3af494ffbd4c962fba4601) also looked healthy near the window end. The metrics range query failed every time with SOURCE_ERROR, so I have no error-rate series and no latency baseline. I therefore cannot confirm whether checkout errors are elevated, how often they occur, or whether latency has changed; the metric backend is a gap.
